stock.description: TL Natural Gas Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, sells compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied natural gas in China. The company distributes CNG to retail customers, such as vehicular end-users; and wholesale customers, including urban gas companies, gas refuelling station operators, and industrial users. It also offers digital marketing and automated car wash services, as well as CNG transmission services. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Jingzhou, China.
